title: SPECIAL REGULATIONS FOR CERTAIN AREAS
previewText: Developments or enlargements in the former Special Greenwich Street Development District built prior to August 27, 1998, will continue to be governed by the regulations in effect at the time of issuance of the building permit and can only be modified or altered by Sections 91-71 through 91-73, inclusive.
